Name: MITRE ATT&CK Cloud Matrix for OCI
Description: MITRE ATT&CK matrix for enterprise cloud tactics and techniques across Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments.

Requirements.Name: Initial Access: Ingress Filtering & Account Compromise Prevention
Requirements.Description: Defend against adversary initial access techniques through perimeter network filtering, private databases, and MFA enforcement.

Requirements.Name: Execution: Secure Compute Instance Configuration
Requirements.Description: Prevent unauthorized command execution and metadata service exploitation on cloud compute instances.

Requirements.Name: Persistence: IAM Credential Lifecycle & Token Rotation
Requirements.Description: Prevent adversaries from maintaining access via persistent API keys, user tokens, or backdoor accounts.

Requirements.Name: Privilege Escalation: Compartment Isolation & Root Restrictions
Requirements.Description: Prevent adversaries from escalating privileges from low-level access to full tenancy administrative control.

Requirements.Name: Defense Evasion: Audit Trail Protection & Cloud Guard Detection
Requirements.Description: Prevent adversaries from disabling security monitoring, deleting audit logs, or modifying detection rules.

Requirements.Name: Credential Access: Password Policy & Authentication Hardening
Requirements.Description: Prevent adversaries from harvesting or cracking cloud credentials using strong password policies and MFA.

Requirements.Name: Discovery: Cloud Posture & Configuration Assessment
Requirements.Description: Monitor and limit unauthorized discovery of cloud tenancy structure, resources, and storage.

Requirements.Name: Lateral Movement: Virtual Cloud Network (VCN) Segmentation
Requirements.Description: Prevent adversaries from pivoting between internal subnets, database instances, and analytics tiers.

Requirements.Name: Collection: Object Storage Public Exposure Mitigation
Requirements.Description: Prevent adversaries from harvesting sensitive organizational data stored in unauthenticated object storage buckets.

Requirements.Name: Exfiltration: Cryptographic Keys & Transit Protection
Requirements.Description: Mitigate data exfiltration risks by enforcing customer-managed keys (CMK) and monitoring key rotation.

Requirements.Name: Impact: Volume Encryption & Automated Backup Protection
Requirements.Description: Protect against ransomware, data destruction, and operational disruption through volume encryption and backups.
